concept.internal_detail: tightly wound brass mainsprings and escapement wheels
concept.button: a small raised steel stud near the rim
concept.shell_mechanic: The circular steel dish splits along its radial score lines and the two halves fold backward like hinged wings
concept.emerging_parts: An elongated articulated torso, four short jointed legs, and a slender pivoting head

concept.button: a flush copper button on the bottom corner
concept.shell_mechanic: The triangular ingot separates along its central ridge and the side plates slide outward on hidden tracks
concept.emerging_parts: A rounded torso block, two hinged wing panels, and a swiveling round optic head
concept.signature_move: its round glass lens lights up amber, and its head turns in a sharp ninety-degree arc with a tiny ratchet click
